thesis: A service-led elevator franchise with ROIC rising to 58.0% still trades below its own 5-year minimum on every multiple and below peers, pricing a transitory margin squeeze and CEO transition as permanent impairment.
reason: Reaching base fair value has not completed the thesis. Multiples remain below their own 5-year floor and below peers, returns are rising and Q3 service and modernization growth was solid. Stalled margins, rising leverage and a stretched short-term chart rule out an ADD. No trigger has fired, so the existing size is kept.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below the FY2021 5-year low of 15.2%, showing the service-margin squeeze is structural.
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2025 5-year low of 10.0%, showing cash generation is deteriorating with margins.
Net debt/EBITDA on the ratios page rises above 3.5x (3.12x TTM now), showing capital returns are outrunning cash generation.
Service operating margin in the earnings release falls below 20% for two consecutive quarters, or modernization backlog growth turns negative.

thesis: A high-return, unlevered core-banking franchise whose returns and margins have improved since entry still trades below its own 5-year median multiples, but the price now implies growth above what has been delivered, so the remaining upside is modest.
reason: Quality is improving and multiples are still below their own history, so the thesis has not broken. But the mispricing that justified entry has largely closed: the reverse DCF now needs above-trend growth and the DCF range sits below the price. Conviction falls to 3. Hold the existing position; no add, and no forced sale while fundamentals keep improving.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 19%, the FY2024 trough, evidencing moat erosion.
TTM operating margin falls below 22%, under the FY2024 low of 22.1%, showing cloud/AI/security investment or renewal pricing is compressing profitability structurally.
TTM FCF margin falls below 20%, reversing the 5-year rising trend (FY2026 27.3%).
Processing revenue growth in the 10-Q MD&A falls below 5% year on year for two consecutive quarters.

thesis: A deleveraging, high-ROIC domain and SMB-software franchise with a 33.7% FCF margin trades below its own 5-year minimum EV/EBITDA and P/FCF, where the price implies a revenue decline that growing bookings and raised guidance do not show.
reason: Thesis intact: Q3 beat, margins and cash still rising, valuation still below own-history floors. Newly disclosed AI risk, a Core segment growing only slowly, partly price-led bookings and the class action keep conviction at 4, not 5, so no ADD. The position is already around its conviction size; hold it.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 20%, reversing most of the five-year improvement from 12.5% (FY2021) to 28.7%.
TTM operating margin falls below 20%, erasing the post-2023 step-up (FY2024 20.4%).
TTM FCF margin falls below 25%, under the FY2024 level of 27.6%, showing the cash gains were transitory.
Total bookings growth in the 10-Q/earnings release falls below 4% y/y for two consecutive quarters (AI substitution showing in demand), or net debt/EBITDA on the ratios page rises above 3.0x.

thesis: A net-cash games franchise with operating margin up to 35.2% and a 43.5% FCF margin trades below its own 5-year minimum EV/EBITDA and near its P/FCF low, where the price implies a revenue decline its improving fundamentals do not show.
reason: Thesis intact and every trigger clear; multiples remain at the bottom of their own range. But the base fair value gap has narrowed and the bear value sits well below the price, so the skew no longer justifies adding ahead of Nov 19 results. Keep the existing size; no trim warranted while quality keeps rising.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below the FY2024 level of 28.1%, reversing the five-year expansion.
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2024 level of 36.5%, signalling cash generation is no longer keeping pace.
TTM gross margin falls below the FY2024 level of 62.5%, indicating game-portfolio mix or monetization is deteriorating.
A new PRC regulation materially restricts game monetization, or a VIE-related regulatory action forces deconsolidation, as disclosed in a company filing or release.

thesis: A net-cash, 70%+-ROIC footwear brand owner trades below its own 5-year minimum P/E, EV/EBITDA and P/FCF at a 9.09% FCF yield with 6.97% annual share shrinkage, pricing a revenue decline that beat-and-guide-growth results do not show.
reason: Margins, cash conversion and net cash are intact and valuation is below every 5y low, so the thesis holds at conviction 4 and the position stays at its conviction size. The guidance cut, rival discounting and falling ROIC leave growth unresolved, so there is no case for conviction 5 or an ADD. Macro is context only.

triggers.text: TTM gross margin falls below 55%, under the FY2024 level of 55.6%, showing rival discounting is eroding full-price discipline.
TTM operating margin falls below 20%, reversing most of the five-year expansion from 18.0%.
TTM ROIC falls below 60%, under the FY2022 five-year low of 60.8%, showing brand-moat economics are deteriorating.
FY2027 annual revenue (income statement page) declines year on year, showing HOKA and UGG together are shrinking rather than slowing.
